---- Respondents (Cause-title taken from Case Information System) 12/07/2024 Heard Mr. Shikhar Bhaktiyar,
learned counsel for the petitioners.
Also heard Mr.Sakib Ahmad, learned Panel lawyer, appearing for respondent No. 1/State and perused the impugned FIR as well as material brought on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that there is a matrimonial dispute between petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 and marriage between them was solemnized on 02.11.2020 and the present FIR has been lodged by respondent No. 2 against the petitioners for harassment on 16.08.2022.
He further submits that the present matter be referred to Mediation & Conciliation Centre of this Court being matrimonial in nature as there may be chances of compromise between the parties.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the dispute arrived at between the parties i.e. petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 is matrimonial in nature, we deem it appropriate to make an efort to get the said dispute settled by way of mediation.

In view of the above, petitioner No. 1 shall deposit Rs.40,000/- before the Mediation Centre of this Court within two weeks from today and the same shall be paid to respondent No. 2 on her appearance before the Mediation Centre.

The matter is remitted to the Mediation Centre with a direction that the Mediation Centre shall conclude the mediation and conciliation proceedings expeditiously, preferably within a period of two months after giving notices to both the parties.
List this matter thereafter along with report of Mediation Centre.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings pursuant to the FIR No.0150/2022 registered at Mahila Thana, Raipur for ofence under Section 498A/34 of the IPC against the petitioners, shall remain stayed.
After depositing the amount as aforesaid, notices shall be issued to the parties.

It is made clear that in case the aforesaid amount is not deposited within the stipulated period, the interim protection granted above shall automatically be vacated and this petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to any Bench of this Court.
It is also made clear that, if any, inal settlement is arrived at between the parties, the aforesaid amount so deposited, shall be adjusted.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
